annotations.title: Demand map of the paid x402 economy

description: Before choosing what to build or how to price it: 20 categories with listings, sellers, 30-day payers and paid calls, estimated gross, leader share, gap score and verdict, the biggest opportunities, price bands, Base vs Solana and the most-paid listings. Optional category (deep dive) and network. No parameters needed. PAID: $0.20 per call, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a Route Pass (header Authorization: Bearer ap1...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/market.

category.description: Optional deep dive into one category: x402-test, wallet-exec, token-risk, compliance, prediction, people-data, social, weather-geo, fin-trad, market-data, onchain-data, web-search, web-scrape, llm, media-gen, news-research, agent-infra, dev-tools, real-world, other (default all)

network.description: all (default) | base | solana: only listings that accept this network
